title: Improve how PMs are hired and onboarded
summary: Fair, structured hiring and a good first few months shape the product team for years. Use the career framework to hire and onboard consistently.

beginner: Base the job description on the career framework.
Use the same questions and scoring for every candidate.
Train interviewers on the questions and scoring.
Write an onboarding plan for the first 90 days.
Ask new joiners what helped and what was missing.
intermediate: Use a work sample that reflects the real job.
Pair new joiners with a buddy.
experienced: Set hiring standards across the product organisation.
Track hiring quality and new-joiner success.
Build a pipeline of future product leaders.

canDelegateTo.task: Run the hiring process and onboarding logistics

definitionOfDone: Structured questions and scoring in use

sources.title: Product manager role and levels (Government Digital and Data Capability Framework)
